construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: schema_version=1, synthetic=true, customers[], ledger{format,data}, loans[], feedback[]
shared_schema.transaction: id, customer_id, amount(decimal string), currency(three uppercase letters), booking_date(YYYY-MM-DD), description, screening_flags[], card_number(13-19 digits or empty; input only)
shared_schema.loan: id, customer_id, positive amount, currency, status(draft|submitted|closed), documents_complete(boolean)
shared_schema.feedback: id, customer_id, entity_type(customer|transaction|loan), entity_id, text, sentiment(negative|neutral|positive); entity ownership required

ledger_formats.json: data is a list of transaction objects
ledger_formats.csv: data is CSV text with exactly the transaction fields as unique headers; screening_flags separated by |
ledger_formats.iso20022: data.Document.CstmrCdtTrfInitn.PmtInf[].CdtTrfTxInf[]: PmtId.EndToEndId, Dbtr.Id, Amt.InstdAmt{value,Ccy}, ReqdExctnDt, RmtInf.Ustrd, ScreeningFlags[], CardNumber. Positive transfer amounts only. Demonstrative JSON subset, not ISO conformance.

shared_schema.normalized_envelope: schema_version, synthetic, stage, customers[], transactions[](masked_card replaces card_number), loans[], feedback[], onboarding[], insights[]
shared_schema.output: status=ok, data=final normalized envelope, notice. Errors: status=error, message; exit 2.
shared_schema.validation: One validate function enforces schemas, unique IDs, foreign keys, ownership, bounded decimal amounts, calendar dates, privacy and stage invariants; derived results and explanations are recomputed at handoff.

cross_stage_handoffs.data: Canonical transactions, masked evidence, customer/KYC profiles, loan applications and feedback
Customer next steps and screening-blocked statuses enrich theme evidence and priority scores

behavior.onboarding: Personalized next step, screening hold before KYC before loan documents before goal/history guidance; human review for screening and loan decisions.
behavior.insights: Deterministic first-match keyword themes in order: loans, verification, payments, fees, support, other. Loan-specific terminology takes precedence over generic document mentions. Actionable recommendations, evidence IDs and onboarding context; empty feedback yields no themes.
behavior.scores: Every score includes formula, component contributions, range, rules version and limitations. Readiness gates to zero for incomplete KYC or screening flags. Theme priority=min(100,15*negative feedback+20*unique blocked customers+5*feedback count).
behavior.privacy: Mask input card fields and card-like digit sequences in names/descriptions/feedback to last four digits; reject unsafe remaining digit sequences. Generic errors never echo input.
behavior.synthetic_fixtures: Fabricated names and visibly fake account/IBANs. Fixed sample ledger plus deterministic seeded randomized histories in tests (seed 3702).
behavior.determinism: No clock, provider, network or runtime randomness in business logic. Stable priority ordering and caller input preserved.

coverage: Validated cross-stage propagation and tamper rejection
CLI success, invalid input and file failures
